from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document record containing its title and legal cause details."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The official case cause (案由) stated in the document")
    administrative_behavior_type: str | None = Field(description="The category of administrative behavior involved, e.g., administrative punishment, compensation")
    specific_punishments: list[str] | None = Field(description="Specific punishment measures mentioned, e.g., fine, detention, revocation")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short excerpt from the document anchoring the case cause or administrative act")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates records from all processed judgment documents."""
    documents: list[Document]
